reviews.title: Great for planning and sharing ideas
reviews.text:
I tried the free trial today and loved the ability to add way points and customize my cycle ahead of time. Also enjoyed the ability to download the route offline. 

I did not like the experience of riding and navigating with the app because I couldn’t get the next instruction to stay on my Apple Watch display. And then when I did adjust settings to permanently keep the app open it gave incorrect instructions. 

I was also unable to change the route while it was active. A pity, because I ended up reverting to Apple Maps for the second half of my ride.

reviews.title: 50 mile century ride Denver
reviews.text: I would give this app  a D grade. The app told me to go right when I was supposed to go straight. The app told me to get onto the street when I was already on the street. I truly believe that there was a crash because of this Ride with GPS direction. The GPS said to turn right but the directions on the route had us turning left and one cyclist ran into another cyclist because they were crisscrossing. The crash was bad and I’m not sure if the rider that ended got to finish the event but I would say it was 100% blamed on the Ride with GPS app.

reviews.title: Good app but $$
reviews.text:
Ride with GPS is a fantastic tool for cyclists to track and plan rides.  

The price has become excessive in the last year. The monthly subscription has increased 30% . It’s a good tool but I don’t know if it’s good enough to support the developer at those prices. I was happy at $9.99/ month. I pay monthly because I don’t use it enough to make the annual fee worthwhile. I don’t know if I use it enough to make $12.99 worthwhile.  I’m hoping there will be enough pushback that the developer will reduce the pricing to where it was previously.

reviews.title: Best app for bikers of all types
reviews.text:
Very smartly designed by people who actually ride.

Enjoyment, not competition, focused.

Route planning, following a route, tracking your ride, finding a route, stats, adding photos, notes, waypoints…. RWGPS does it all beautifully.

I especially love being able to follow a route with voice cues in and area without cell service and simultaneously track what I’m actually riding.
